variants.headline: Full shelves, empty household purses
variants.body: Food is for sale, but households cannot afford it and are going hungry beside full shelves. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Food for sale beyond the buyer's means
variants.body: Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Hunger beside food that cannot be afforded
variants.body: There is food on the shelves, but people without enough money cannot obtain their meals. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
